$comment: Health config. Copied to config.json on first install. `units` labels every number on the page (metric or imperial); `workspaces` are the folders the work signals read commit times from, so the body-and-work join has something to join to — an empty list means no work signals and no card claiming them. Nothing here changes what the phone reads: HealthKit lives on the iPhone, and this Mac only keeps what the phone sends.
